# Development

> **Status:** Stub — content to be expanded.

## Overview

How to set up a local development environment for `barangay` and run the standard verification commands.

## Setup

```bash
uv sync
uv run pre-commit install
```

## Verification

```bash
uv run ruff check --fix --exit-non-zero-on-fix --ignore E741
uv run ruff format
uv run ty check
uv run pytest
```
